hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: The pink/blue-gray palette shows some color intentionality, but the circle pack layout is clipped mid-render with the visualization spilling below the viewport — a concrete layout bug that caps the score regardless of the edge-bundling technique.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: scaleSqrt for both force-layout node radii and sunburst radial scale, data-driven domains via d3.extent/root.height, key functions on node and link joins — only minor gap is missing key function on hierarchy-link join, a small permutation-robustness risk.
flags: Update Storm: easing parameter sliders fire full updateLayout() on every input event without debouncing, triggering repeated 1500ms transitions
Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() called on nodeSelection before new transitions begin; rapidly switching layouts or dragging easing sliders causes mid-flight conflicts
Mouse-Touch Fight: mouseover/mouseout/click handlers have no touch event filtering or event.preventDefault(), allowing ghost interactions on mobile
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider is correctly RAF-throttled, but easing/amplitude/period sliders fire full layout re-transitions on every input tick without debouncing, causing cascading mid-flight interruptions and update storms.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle pack hierarchy reads clearly with a clean 2-color palette, but the edge bundles collapse into an untraceable dark mass at center — individual connections are indistinguishable without hover interaction, which cannot be evaluated from the static screenshot.
